about: Every OVERCLEAN announcement (scripts/overclean_announcer.gd) plus the Phase 0 sound effects. Remake them all with: python tools/cypurr_sound.py batch tools/sound_specs/overclean.json  (needs internet for the voice). The subtitles in the game are typed in the Announcer node's Inspector: keep them matching the text here. NPC voice blips are in npc_voices.json.

jobs.text: Attention citizens. Unregistered shedding has been detected in this sector. Please remain still for disposal.
Attention citizens. A stray has entered a clean zone. Please remain still for disposal.
Good evening, citizens. Unauthorized paw prints have been detected on the pavement. Disposal units are on their way.
Cleanliness alert. Hairball levels exceeding municipal tolerance. Additional VAC-COPs dispatched.
Warning. Unauthorized fish handling in progress. Littering is punishable by immediate suction.
Critical mess threshold reached. Please step into the nearest dustbin in an orderly fashion.
Heavy sanitation unit deployed. Have a spotless day.
Sector quarantine initiated. Commencing total Deep Clean. Thank you for your cooperation.
One stray removed from the premises. Street hygiene restored by 14 percent.
